required_runtime_witness: React/Chromium -> Vite -> test-profile Spring -> disposable PostgreSQL
module_boundaries: Application review facts are read through ReviewStatusFactsPort.
Payment/dispatch facts are read through ReviewPaymentFactsPort.
The controller and fixture adapters use no cross-module repository.
reset_and_persistence: Every integration starts with fresh disposable PostgreSQL. The browser resets only cap114_harness fixture rows between scenarios. A Spring restart against the same disposable database preserves the final safe summary.
positive_controls: Three distinct 6/100 windows transition PENDING, PENDING, FIRING.
Repeated window key is idempotent; one additional 7/100 window does not fire twice.
NEEDS_INFORMATION display is separate from operational alert state and payment/dispatch status.
negative_controls: Invalid error count returns 400 without a window write.
Exactly 5/100 over three full windows does not fire.
1/2 low-volume window and later healthy window remain NORMAL.
Database constraints reject malformed IDs and errors greater than eligible volume.
Reusing a window ID with altered fixture values is rejected.
limits: The application-level ReviewAlertWindow learner method still throws its explicit TODO.
The instructor reference reducer, synthetic principal, route and SQL schema are test-only.
The ordinary application has no Support route, authenticated role adapter, production alert store, or production UI placement.
No insurer callback, payment operation, dispatch, issuance, active cover, customer data, provider SLA, or model run is represented.
